answer: Each walnut must be sponsored on a terrace, a shared registry that tallies how many newcomers every sponsor backs. A sponsor's bond doubles with each walnut it vouches for, so the tenth locks 512 times the first in crystal, and all of it is slashed if any backed walnut colludes. A thousand clones therefore demand a thousand unrelated funded sponsors or ruinous crystal. The terrace merges sponsors that share funding sources, so splitting fails. It breaks if unrelated sponsors can be bribed for less than their bond.
